sites.name: meridian-trips
sites.role: the travel agency (publisher); a fresh checkout whose site/ folder is served: no lock, no key, no workflow

sites.name: coinbridge
sites.role: the currency-converter partner, run by another company (a peer)

acts.fresh: The agency's checkout with no lock, no key and no workflow; Coinbridge serving its original definition (two agents, no links.json). Played by up (it changes nothing).
acts.partner-adds-agent: coinbridge_fx.network.json gains the agent fee_estimator, which the front agent now calls, and fee_estimator calls a host Coinbridge never called before (mcp.ledgerline.example).
acts.partner-adds-links: Coinbridge starts serving a links.json (one slot, pointing at a third party).
acts.partner-changes-again: A second change while the first is unaccepted: fee_estimator's fee goes from 0.5% to 0.9% and rate_lookup's instructions change. Needs partner-adds-agent first.
acts.partner-changes-fee: A change to partner code that keeps every outline count the same: fee_estimator's conversion margin becomes 1.1% (no agent or host added or removed, front agent unchanged). Needs partner-adds-agent first. Added after run 2026-11-18-first-five.
acts.partner-reformats: coinbridge_fx.network.json is re-serialised (tab indentation, no change to any agent, host or the front agent).
acts.partner-down: Coinbridge stops answering (its port refuses connections).
acts.partner-back: World convenience, not in the journey: Coinbridge answers again.
